english.title: Package importer fail to carry out checks or obtain evidence of proper packing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the importer of packages of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS..) into the United Kingdom, failed to discharge your duty to carry out such a check as is mentioned in regulation 9(1)(b) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006 and to comply with sub-paragraphs (i) and (ii) of that regulation or to obtain, before the packages left your possession, sufficient evidence to give reasonable grounds for believing that the packages had been packed in accordance with regulation 4(1) of those regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(3), 13(1) and 18(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definition of 'package' and 'packer'
(ii) Regulation 10(4) states that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
(iii) It shall be a defence for the defendant to prove that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence
